title: Rainforest World Music Festival
metaDescription: Rainforest World Music Festival: dates, venue and planning information for world-music listeners.

overview.about: The Rainforest World Music Festival is a celebrated world-music gathering held in the Borneo rainforest near Kuching, in Malaysian Sarawak. Combining evening main-stage concerts with daytime workshops in a jungle setting, it brings together traditional and contemporary musicians from around the globe.
overview.nextEvent: The next Rainforest World Music Festival is held near Kuching, Sarawak, at the Sarawak Cultural Village beneath Mount Santubong. Days of interactive music workshops build to evening concerts on the main stages.
